detailsNote: The official intake is summer, not fall. December 1 is published without a calendar year; confirm the intended application cycle.

publishedDeadlines.label: Final application deadline — summer entry
publishedDeadlines.note: No admission year attached to the deadline. Central portal says all materials due by 11:59 p.m. ET.

english.note: Official scores valid two years. US or English-medium bachelor’s/advanced degree, including expected conferral before program starts, demonstrates proficiency; if transcript does not state English instruction, upload university registrar documentation. Otherwise tests required; no discretionary waivers. DET, TOEFL MyBest, IELTS One Skill Retake and Cambridge not accepted. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS Online academic accepted.

applicationFee.note: Affiliation/recruitment waivers include designated programs, Georgetown bachelor’s alumni 2024–2027, military and selected federal workers. Financial-need route is US-citizens-only. Other categories are not generally US-only; international applicants should confirm eligibility. Request separately for each program at least five days before deadline; no reimbursement. Early submission waiver applies only to master’s/certificate programs, not this PhD.

documents: Copies of official transcripts from undergraduate/graduate institutions with more than 15 credits, or any prerequisite credits; English translations if needed
Full CV/resume, at least 11-point font: dated relevant experiences, research PI, publications/abstracts/presentations if applicable
Optional statement on diversity, personal background and contributions
External sponsorship award letter if funded for the entire PhD
Neuroscience supplemental essay, maximum one page: research failure, response and lessons
If applying for optional Cognitive Science concentration: select it and submit a one-page interest essay
requirements.note: Four-year bachelor’s degree/equivalent with GPA at least 3.0. Formal PhD interview required. All required credentials/supporting documents due by application deadline. Upload official transcript copies; student portal downloads, screenshots/photos are not accepted. Official delivery normally requested after offer. Credential evaluation must include course/grades and transcripts if not part of report. WES/NACES international evaluation strongly encouraged. GRE not considered. Statement should discuss motivation, preparation, research, fit and career goals, identifying two or three possible faculty; FAQ recommends graduate-school 500-word rule while allowing longer essays. Students enter program and complete three rotations before committing to a laboratory. Letters: Professors, research mentors or employers able to assess graduate potential.

funding.note: Merit-based fellowships may cover tuition, stipend, health/dental insurance and mandatory fees, subject to full-time enrollment and satisfactory progress; funding is not guaranteed by admission. Central published 2026–27 stipend is $44,605 for 12 months or $40,922 for nine months, not a 2027–28 guarantee. No international funding guarantee established.

timeline.interviews: January–March; recurring summer-admission schedule, no year stated.
timeline.decisions: Final decisions late March; enrollment response April 15; program begins July 1. Recurring schedule, no year stated.
